title: Auto-start streams with the old output mode and encoder even after deciding OBS needs a restart
test: tests/obsWebSocket.test.js: 'auto-start is not sent when OBS needs a restart for the new output mode, and the result says so (VAL-119)'; guard that passed before and after: 'with no restart needed, auto-start still starts the stream and the result says no restart is needed'
proof: Failed before the fix: on the unchanged code the restart case returned no restartRequired field ('undefined !== true' at the restartRequired assertion, which runs before the StartStream check; the old code also sent StartStream there, since autoStart gated only on the flag). Fix: configureObsStream sets a restartRequired flag where the mode/encoder warning is pushed, skips the autoStart block (the settle delay, StartStream and the streaming-check) when it is set, and returns restartRequired on the success result. Committed settings are unchanged (no rollback on the skipped start).
